name: Aylesbury Foodbank
short_description: Trussell Trust foodbank at St Peter's Centre
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network. Provides emergency food parcels and support to local residents in crisis. Open Mondays and Thursdays.

name: Aylesbury Community Garden
short_description: Community garden at Alfred Rose Park with 40 plots
description: Managed by Aylesbury Community Garden Association
months: this garden provides growing space and runs therapeutic horticulture sessions.

name: Aylesbury Community Fridge
short_description: Community fridge at Aylesbury Library reducing food waste
months: this fridge allows residents to share surplus food. Open Monday-Saturday during library hours.
